e02059e021c6be76a0a50748e0697a98.overview: A street-gang leader challenges a handsome young skater in a championship contest at the local roller-disco rink.
e02059e021c6be76a0a50748e0697a98.tagline: The Rock and Roller Disco Movie of the Year!

e0580aaefe8bdf1020ce852c48f7415c.overview: Passing through a border town, a man is caught up in a Mexican's murder of a member of the town's most powerful family.

e05f96b69422b9e016515de191d22a60.overview: A New York nightclub manager tries to save his brother and father from Russian mafia hitmen.
e05f96b69422b9e016515de191d22a60.tagline: Two brothers on opposite sides of the law. Beyond their differences lies loyalty.

e085bc3888c8907ec1e085b8a577185e.overview: A novelist fed up with the establishment profiting from "Black" entertainment uses a pen name to write a book that propels him into the heart of hypocrisy and the madness he claims to disdain.
e085bc3888c8907ec1e085b8a577185e.tagline: Once you go full black, you ain't never going back!

e094629d7a81e0c040d8a66d41759802.overview: An unathletic college freshman ridiculed by his peers for his mannerisms strives to become popular by making the football team.
e094629d7a81e0c040d8a66d41759802.tagline: Harold kicks the fun winning Goal.

e09a6071d4b6be91456ff7038a6e1b8a.overview: A middle-class family flees an unspecified disaster that has struck the city and takes refuge in their country home. They think this will allow them to escape the chaos, but they soon realize that getting away won’t be so easy.

e0b1988a6351a5597da82be4a848544b.overview: A ghost and a French marquis wander through the Winter Palace in St Petersburg, encountering scenes from many different periods of its history.
e0b1988a6351a5597da82be4a848544b.tagline: 2000 cast members, 3 orchestras, 33 rooms, 300 years, ALL IN ONE TAKE

e0ca3116246142ef16e9d91fdd6c2fda.overview: This Surrealist film, with a title referencing the Communist Manifesto, strings together short incidents based on the life of director Luis Buñuel. Presented as chance encounters, these loosely related, intersecting situations, all without a consistent protagonist, reach from the 19th century to the 1970s. Touching briefly on subjects such as execution, pedophilia, incest, and sex, the film features an array of characters, including a sick father and incompetent police officers.

e0d496fe06b4cd7a42e07ce22afb5c08.overview: The Cavalcade of Perversion, a traveling freak show, acts as a front for Divine, who is out for blood after discovering her lover's affair.

e0f055b8836b3c1a92094cac91a21329.overview: To ensure a full profitable season, circus manager Brad Braden engages The Great Sebastian, though this moves his girlfriend Holly from her hard-won center trapeze spot. Holly and Sebastian begin a dangerous one-upmanship duel in the ring, while he pursues her on the ground.
e0f055b8836b3c1a92094cac91a21329.tagline: The Heartbeat Story of Circus People, Filmed with the Cooperation of Ringling Bros. - Barnum and Bailey Circus!

e0f2f298ceb09abcc71ccff0a66b8908.overview: Takes us to locations all around the US and shows us the heavy toll that modern technology is having on humans and the earth. The visual tone poem contains neither dialogue nor a vocalized narration: its tone is set by the juxtaposition of images and the exceptional music by Philip Glass.
